title: Loto6 LocalCore5+ exploratory study
data_integrity: 2151 verified across two public sources; forward features only, rolling window corrected to exact previous 300
scope: Hypothesis-generating retrospective analysis. Prior successes may have been known when model was designed; not independently held out.

routes.raw: sum of six historical pair counts over previous 300 draws
routes.lift: raw minus expected pair count based on marginal number frequencies
routes.number: sum of individual number frequencies over previous 300 draws

method.ranking: Top two unique 4-number cores per route; ties lexicographic
method.completion: For each core choose 10 distinct remaining numbers with highest sum of pair co-occurrences to that core plus 0.2 times number frequency, then pair adjacent numbers into 5 tickets. Two cores x 5 tickets =10. No winning-draw features used.
method.metrics: for each draw maximum correct-number match across final 10 tickets; separate count when at least one selected core contains 4 of the 6 winners

decision: Research-only: number route retains two exploratory 5+ historical events across 724 draws, one in the 500-draw evaluation period. No reliable uplift demonstrated, cannot claim prespecified validation. Avoid promoting this to main purchase model. Freeze 2152 shadow set and require predeclared trigger.
risk_notes: Multiple routes were compared; selective reporting biases any p-value.
All portfolio constructions here intentionally cluster tickets around 4-number cores, not maximize lower prize cover.
The 2152 top2 cores are tied on ranking strength, so no strong-confidence activation; shadow-only.
